title: DPPA–DPO regional political-operational functions
decision_reason: Retained sources support a bounded validation question; complete operational/financial records, accountable owner confirmation and applicable authority are absent.
current_arrangement: The retained budget narratives describe an existing shared regional political-operational structure and further consolidation. The DPO support-account slice is not the cost of the entire joint structure.
testable_mechanism: Trace actual country/region task ownership, separately resourced preparation and clearance against the already shared structure; test whether a residual parallel task is substitutable rather than a needed political, military or mission-control contribution.
feasible_alternative_to_test: Adjust a named intake, task-routing or factual-support step inside existing joint arrangements, conditional on owners confirming an unmet function; retain current structure where distinct substantive contributions are required.
safeguards: Protect political independence, military/operational expertise and crisis-response coverage
Retain regional/country mandate distinctions and accountable substantive clearance
Do not create a parallel central repository or management layer before checking existing shared controls
cost_perimeter_and_nonadditivity: SA02 10,196.1 thousand is a DPO support-account portion, not whole-system joint-office cost or duplicative expenditure. Reconcile regular, support-account and extrabudgetary funds, unique staff assignments and mission inputs. Existing integration is the baseline; overlap with C14 cannot be added.
minimum_records: Approved and actual organizational charts, country-desk assignments and unique post/fund roster
Current source-to-product workflow and task ownership on comparable live examples
Actual staff effort, shared products, queues, revisions, quality and crisis coverage
Full funding/cost-centre map and already implemented or budgeted reform changes
custodian_roles_to_confirm: DPPA and DPO regional leadership and shared desk managers
Departmental executive offices, HR and budget custodians
Receiving mission substantive and operational owners

source_snapshot.verification_needed: HR roster; shared organigrams; products; cost centre; 2025/26 revised baseline
source_snapshot.risk_control: Do not classify 10196.1 as duplicative cost

source_snapshot.attribution_limit: DPO support-account portion; NOT whole DPPA-DPO joint-structure cost

case_specific_limit: Shared attendance, reporting tables or related geography do not establish duplicate substantive work, duplicate funding or implemented savings.
handling: No identifiable payroll, participant, medical, security, live transaction or restricted clearance records in this public dossier; use authorized restricted intake and approved safe derivatives.
reopen_condition: Confirm owner and authority, obtain authenticated complete linked records, define comparator and guardrails, and adjudicate validation-ready evidence. A prepared request or software pass is insufficient.
